description: Typed TypeScript SDK for supported Tradernet API v2 broker report and user cash flow endpoints.
rules: Import TradernetApiClient, constants, and types only from @kofeinstyle/tradernet-sdk.
Check response.success before accessing response.data or error fields.
Use getBrokerReport with corporate_actions for security-level dividend details and getUserCashFlows for account ledger operations.
Broker reports default to the 23:59:59 time period unless 08:40:00 is explicitly required.
Do not suggest API v3, WebSocket, order placement, or other methods that are not part of the documented public API.
